questions.already_established: Scoring rules for IT-MAIS, CAP-II, MUSS and SIR are present in the source documentation; the numeric columns exist.
questions.fallback_if_unanswered: instrument_resolved=UNKNOWN; primary target cannot be a single confirmed instrument.
questions.question: Which clinical rows use IT-MAIS and which use MAIS, under which version, and with what age applicability?
questions.still_required: Per-row or per-batch instrument identity and version, from the clinical team or a traceable original.

questions.already_established: EEG acquisition times exist; the clinical table carries a label date.
questions.fallback_if_unanswered: eeg_visit_relation=UNKNOWN; no time tolerance is invented and no zero interval is assumed.
questions.question: Is the questionnaire the same clinical assessment as the EEG visit, and what does the table's date column denote?
questions.still_required: Same-visit confirmation, or a dated interval plus an explicit applicability rule confirmed before any new EEG outcome analysis.

questions.already_established: Candidate identity and worksheet-row linkage are audited; the corrected row key is in place.
questions.fallback_if_unanswered: identity_status stays conflict or supported_candidate; such records stay out of the primary cohort.
questions.question: Are there known wrong-person, duplicate-export or visit-confusion cases among the currently unresolved records?
questions.still_required: Adjudication of the remaining conflicts only; resolved records are not re-asked.

questions.already_established: Unaided and aided four-frequency data exist; the PTA row key is corrected.
questions.fallback_if_unanswered: device state stays UNKNOWN, which limits the wording of any conclusion but is NOT by itself a general exclusion; unknown PTA units restrict which clinical context a claim may cite.
questions.question: What units and test conditions do the audiometric columns use, and was the device worn or powered during acquisition?
questions.still_required: Unit and condition confirmation; any recorded mid-session device change.
